title: zatara-netcoredbg debug scenario
description: The documented key set for zatara debug.json scenarios. The config object is the one launch config that crosses the extension/proxy boundary (zatara-types::LaunchConfig, SCHEMA_EQ) - keys beyond these are rejected, not ignored (survey Recommendation 3: tightened adapter schema).

label.description: Name shown in Zed's debug UI.

config.description: The one launch config that crosses the extension/proxy boundary. One key set serves both lanes (SCHEMA_EQ: these properties equal zatara-types::LaunchConfig's serde fields): a config carrying a program or request key takes the program/attach lane, every other config is the test lane and must name its target.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the .csproj the test lives in.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Exact test FQN (a [Theory] case display name is valid); never a substring filter.

cwd.description: Working directory the proxy runs build and test in.

env.description: Environment the proxy forwards to build and test.

resultsLog.description: Optional, default false. True appends dotnet's own --logger trx to the test step, so each run writes a .trx results file under TestResults/ in the working directory. Absent means off.

scope.description: Gutter-click scope: method (default when absent), case, class, or file. Optional; the shipped gutter locator never emits it.

framework.description: Test framework behind the target (nunit, mstest, xunit), consulted only for case scope. Optional.

caseArguments.description: Displayed arguments of the invoked case, as displayed tokens. Optional.

methodParameters.description: The invoked method's parameter names, zipped with caseArguments to rebuild the named-argument display. Optional.

program.description: Program mode: the dll or apphost to debug. Its presence selects the program lane and releases the config from the test-lane keys.

request.description: What the config asks the proxy to do: launch a program or attach to a running pid. Absent means a test-lane config.

process_id.description: Manual-pid attach target. Snake_case on the wire - a deliberate exception to the camelCase vocabulary, pinned verbatim by the contract's exact JSON shapes.

else.description: The test lane: a config with no program and no request key must name the exact test it debugs.
